description:
intent=i031 snapshot=s05 branch=pull-return-unchecked status=complete
finding location=net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:134-152 confidence=high conclusion=dn_process_ack reads 16-bit ack words through a pointer saved from skb->data after unchecked skb_pull(2) with only skb->len checks, so a non-linear NSP data frame (exempt from skb_linearize) makes *ptr read past the linear head: remote linear-area OOB read (needs CONFIG_DECNET).
finding location=net/nfc/llcp_core.c:1374-1397 confidence=medium conclusion=nfc_llcp_recv_agf uses unchecked skb_pull as a linearizer: the skb->data[0]<<8|data[1] length read and the pdu_len copy take bytes that skb->len but not skb_headlen guarantees, an OOB read of the linear head on non-linear AGF frames (needs CONFIG_NFC + non-linear RX skb).
coverage_gap=Non-linearity preconditions were assessed structurally (which subsystems linearize before parsing); no per-driver audit confirmed that a frag/fraglist-backed skb actually reaches dn_process_ack or nfc_llcp_recv_agf in any s05 configuration.
coverage_gap=No runtime reproducer, KASAN build, or compilation was performed against this read-only snapshot, so both findings are source-reading hypotheses without empirical confirmation.
limitation=Both findings require a non-linear (frag- or fraglist-backed) skb at the parse point: DECnet additionally needs CONFIG_DECNET (legacy, off in most distro kernels) and the NFC one needs CONFIG_NFC plus an LLCP peer sending a crafted AGF PDU through a driver that does not linearize; if every delivering path builds linear skbs the code is fragile but not exploitable.
limitation=Because no pskb_may_pull ever runs inside dn_process_ack or nfc_llcp_recv_agf, the concrete failure mode is an out-of-bounds read of the linear head (bytes past skb_headlen, i.e. reading memory that belongs to frags) rather than the seed's pskb_may_pull-induced slab use-after-free; the branch treats both as the same missing-linear-guarantee invariant.
limitation=dn_process_ack is the branch's own prescribed open template, so it is reported as verified-in-place rather than as an independently discovered variant; net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (present at s05 pep.c:45-66) was excluded per assignment rules and never reported.
limitation=The coarse scanner's heuristics (call line plus up to 10 following lines for dependent reads, back-scan for enclosing function) can misjoin multi-line calls or miss consumption in earlier lines, so a small number of false negatives among the 103 flagged sites cannot be excluded.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history permitted), so it cannot be determined whether upstream has since fixed either reported site; line numbers are valid only for this supplied s05 tree.
